title: Codex on Windows PowerShell reduces prompts with approval_mode=full-auto
summary: A local Windows PowerShell setup used approval_mode=full-auto to reduce repeated approval prompts.
claim: In a Windows PowerShell environment, approval_mode=full-auto reduced repeated approval prompts without disabling all safety boundaries.

steps.action: Set approval_mode=full-auto in the local config.
Restart the CLI session and rerun the same workflow.

result.summary: Prompt frequency dropped while guardrails remained in place.
details: No evidence that sandbox boundaries were disabled.

evidence.summary: Observed fewer approval interruptions after config change.

applicable_if: approval_mode is supported by the local config schema
not_applicable_if: The environment requires manual approval for every destructive action

title: approval_policy key was ignored in one local codex-cli setup
summary: A commonly suggested config key did not affect prompt behavior in the tested local environment.
claim: approval_policy was not a valid or effective config key in the tested client setup.

steps.action: Set approval_policy in the local config.
Rerun the same workflow and compare approval behavior.

result.summary: The expected reduction in prompts did not happen.
details: The config key was ineffective in the tested setup.

evidence.summary: Prompt behavior did not change after editing the key.

not_applicable_if: A different client version accepts approval_policy
